summary: C2 Blockchain, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the entry into Securities Purchase Agreements with Auctus Fund, LLC and Leonite Fund I, LP. Under the agreements, C2 issued a $130,000 promissory note to Auctus at a $117,000 purchase price (13% OID) with a 12% interest charge, convertible at 60% of the lowest traded price over 15 days, plus warrants for 5,200,000 shares at $0.05. The Leonite note provides up to $1,200,000 principal ($1,000,000 funding) with 10% interest, secured by substantially all assets, convertible initially at $0.05 per share. These are routine financing transactions, not special situations.
